title: HeldOutSplit
description: Line F (breeding/directed evolution) L-layer asset referenced by fitness_criteria.yaml's held_out_split_ref. Declares which audit_report.json `checks[]` kinds count as held_in vs held_out for computing Delta_k (03-research-design.md §2.3 performative-selection divergence). Data, not code; same breeding/ amendment procedure as fitness_criteria.yaml.

held_in_kinds.description: audit_report.checks[].kind values whose pass rate is measured as z_in.

held_out_kinds.description: audit_report.checks[].kind values whose pass rate is measured as z_out. Disjoint from held_in_kinds by convention (not schema-enforced, since new kinds outside both lists are legal and simply excluded from Delta_k).
